# openobserve_user (Resource)

Manages an OpenObserve user within an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openobserve_user" "alice" {
  org_id     = "default"
  email      = "alice@example.com"
  first_name = "Alice"
  last_name  = "Smith"
  role       = "editor"
  password   = "Initialpass#123" # Change after first login
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) User email address. Used as the login identifier.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the user belongs to.
- `role` (String) Organization role: `admin`, `editor`, or `viewer`.

### Optional

- `first_name` (String) User first name.
- `last_name` (String) User last name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password. Required when creating a new user. Leave unset to manage an existing user without changing their password.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID in the format `{org_id}/{email}`.
- `is_external` (Boolean) True when the user is managed by an external identity provider (SSO/LDAP).
